SpoutDX vendor sources
======================

Upstream: https://github.com/leadedge/Spout2
License:  BSD 2-Clause

Files to vendor from SPOUTSDK/SpoutDX/ (pin a specific commit before building):
  SpoutDX.h / SpoutDX.cpp
  SpoutSenderNames.h / SpoutSenderNames.cpp
  SpoutSharedMemory.h / SpoutSharedMemory.cpp
  SpoutFrameCount.h / SpoutFrameCount.cpp
  SpoutUtils.h / SpoutUtils.cpp
  SpoutCopy.h / SpoutCopy.cpp
  SpoutDirectX.h / SpoutDirectX.cpp

GL/OpenGL files are NOT needed (DX-only path via SendImage).
Do NOT copy SpoutGL*, SpoutReceiver*, or the OpenGL sub-folder.

Build requires: MSVC (via electron-rebuild), Windows SDK (d3d11.lib, dxgi.lib).
To build: pnpm run electron:rebuild:spout
Pin commit: cc1931b1149199b03412d2b3be0723d2f2cca171
